unit: W2-STATBUFF — stat grants the engine already dispatches
slice: utility-axis census slice 4: nineteen slots stop emitting an unpriced zero row and start granting the stat their cached leveling row states
rule: decision 10 — a unit that moves a golden leaf lands against the committed baselines plus this allowlist. This unit does not re-capture: scripts/golden_baseline.json, scripts/golden_coupled_baseline.json and scripts/golden_coupled_exact.json move in the integration agent's own commit (R-32/R-34), never inside a semantic slice.

pair_golden.shape: Every leaf belongs to one of the seventeen champions this unit owns. The moves are of three kinds: an attack-speed grant raises the fight's auto count (floor(attack_speed x duration x uptime)), an attack-damage / ability-power / bonus-health grant raises the rows whose ratios read that stat, and Rengar's flat armour shred lowers the target's effective armour. Swain and Varus move no number at all: their new rows publish a stat_buff of 0.0 at the declared default, so only the row's shape (rank, parts[0], stat_buff, detail, damage_type) changed.

coupled_golden.shape: Every one of the seven scenarios carries Lulu as an ally (dream_maker_roster carries her as the main). Her W now grants herself the cached 20-30% attack speed and her R the cached 275-575 (+55% AP) bonus health, so her ally fight gains autos and her ledger's event ordinals shift — which is why the diff set is dominated by dispositions/events[N] entries rather than by totals.

coupled_exact.shape: Lulu's outgoing total rises in every scenario that holds her (703.2 -> 814.6 in three of them). Aatrox dies sooner against the extra damage, which is why crit_onhit_carry_roster's main outgoing FALLS (6954.4 -> 6445.5): the survival walk ends earlier.

why: The utility-axis census (docs/plans/utility-axis-census.md, slice 4) measured twenty-two slots whose cached leveling row the fight engine could already fold in through stat_buff's dispatch (damage.py:2739-2821 bonus_attack_speed / total_attack_speed_percent / bonus_attack_damage / bonus_health) or through engine.py's target_debuff, and which emitted a zero-damage row instead. Nineteen of them are this unit's. Tristana's own module said so in its assumptions: 'the AS buff is not applied to the auto count' — for a marksman whose whole output is basic attacks.

worked_example.probe: run_fight, level 18, no items, 5s window, 100% auto uptime, target 2000 HP / 100 armour / 100 MR
worked_example.Tristana: attack speed 0.833 -> 1.6658 (Q's 120% of a 0.694 ratio), autos 4 -> 8, auto damage 236.0 -> 472.0, total 663.50 -> 899.50
worked_example.Olaf: attack speed 1.0385 -> 1.8019 (P at the declared 30% missing health plus W's 80%), attack damage 148 -> 188.2 (R's 30 + 25% AD over 3 of the 5 seconds), total 829.00 -> 1346.10
worked_example.Rengar: effective armour 100 -> 80 (R's 25 flat shred weighted by the 4s window's share of the 5s fight), total 665.95 -> 730.50
worked_example.Varus: 1092.50 -> 1092.50 at the declared default; p_champion_takedown on gives 1341.40

how_to_reproduce: python scripts/golden_snapshot.py compare scripts/golden_baseline.json — 650 differences, all listed below plus the one Samira leaf unit E's receipt claims and the two fingerprint counters an earlier receipt claims.

excluded_by_construction.every champion outside this unit: the edits are seventeen champions/<name>.py modules plus module_helpers.buff_window_share (a new function nothing else calls yet), so no other champion's parse changed.
excluded_by_construction.Swain and Varus numbers: p_soul_fragments and p_champion_takedown default to off, so their rows publish 0.0 and every number they feed is unchanged; only the four shape leaves each are listed.
excluded_by_construction.the item sweep: the sweep runs Ahri and Ziggs, neither of which is this unit's.

landed_against.rule: R-17 — the slice landed against the three committed baselines plus this allowlist; the campaign re-captures once, at integration close.

filename_note: The name sorts after expected-golden-diff-wave-cooldowns.json and expected-golden-diff-surface-area-A2-expose-weakness-pool.json on purpose: tests/test_golden_snapshot.declared_exact_moves folds the coupled_exact maps together with dict.update over the sorted receipt names, so the last name to claim a key is the one that answers for it. Three cleaver_bloodsong_roster keys were already claimed by those two receipts at values this slice moves again; the pairs below carry the committed value as 'old', so both of those receipts' own claims still hold.

described_leaves.why: Amendment E's third guard asks an allowlist claiming a disposition transition to name the leaf the entry describes. These 123 are named below with the value each holds on both sides, measured positionally out of the two snapshots.
described_leaves.measured: 66 of the 123 described leaves MOVED. That is not a citation adjudication and this receipt does not claim it as one: these disposition entries move because the numbers they describe move, and every one of those numbers is claimed in this same allowlist under its real snapshot path (/…/combat/events[N]/damage). The guard's companion clause (test_a_claimed_disposition_transition_moves_no_number) does not see it, because _described_leaf spells the derived path 'events[N].damage' — the dispositions map's own key — while leaf_report spells the snapshot leaf 'events[N]/damage'. The two spellings can never intersect, so the clause is vacuous for every receipt that has ever passed it. Escalated to the campaign rather than fixed here: the fix belongs to whoever owns tests/test_coupled_golden_allowlist.py, and changing it would re-open every committed allowlist.
